description: This file is a C++ source code implementing a data model handler for a device management system. It includes functions for loading and parsing an XML data model, managing parameter lists, handling instances, and matching parameters and objects within the data model. It also interacts with external XML files and data structures, and provides functions for retrieving parameter information and complete parameter lists.

methods.name: loadDataModel
methods.description: Loads the XML data model from a file into memory, initializes parameter list.

methods.name: checkDataModelStatus
methods.description: Checks if the data model handle is loaded successfully.

methods.name: getDataModelHandle
methods.description: Returns the current data model handle.

methods.name: get_complete_param_list
methods.description: Retrieves the complete list of parameters from the data model XML.

methods.name: getChildParamNamesFromDataModel
methods.description: Gets parameter names matching a wildcard pattern from the data model.

methods.name: getParamInfoFromDataModel
methods.description: Retrieves detailed info for a specific parameter, handling instance wildcards.

methods.name: test_get_complete_param_list
methods.description: Test function to verify parameter list retrieval and parameter info extraction.
